item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine with temperatures rising progressively over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cloudier and become humid with mist over the region.
